The '''1990 Supercopa de España''' was two-leg [[Football in Spain|Spanish]] [[football (soccer)|football]] matches played on 5 December and 12 December 1990. It contested by Barcelona, who were Spanish Cup winners in 1989–90, and Real Madrid, who won the [[La Liga 1989–90|1989–90]] Spanish League. Real Madrid won 5&ndash;1 on aggregate.
